english.title: Deposit dung / compost / rubbish on a made-up carriageway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, deposited

(A)_[dung]_
(B)_[compost]_
(C)_[material for dressing land, namely **(..SPECIFY MATERIAL..),]_
(D)_[rubbish]_

on a made-up carriageway, namely **(..SPECIFY CARRIAGEWAY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 148(a) of the Highways Act 1980.

english.notes:
(i) See H4304 - depositing rubbish within 15 feet from centre of a highway
(ii) See also H579 - leaving/depositing litter under the Environmental Protection Act 1990. This offence has a wider application and carries a more severe penalty.
